## Functional identification

This 359-amino-acid protein is **UDP-3-O-acylglucosamine N-acyltransferase (LpxD)**, EC **2.3.1.191**. The sequence is an exact match to reviewed UniProt entry **Q136B3** from *Rhodopseudomonas palustris* BisB5. Full-length reviewed homologs support the assignment, and the sequence contains an LpxD domain. The enzyme is annotated as a homotrimer.

## Catalytic reaction

**UDP-3-O-[(3R)-3-hydroxyacyl]-α-D-glucosamine + (3R)-hydroxyacyl-[ACP] → UDP-2-N,3-O-bis[(3R)-3-hydroxyacyl]-α-D-glucosamine + holo-[ACP] + H⁺**

In other words, LpxD transfers a 3-hydroxyacyl group from acyl carrier protein (ACP) onto the amino group at C-2 of UDP-3-O-acylglucosamine, forming the second acyl linkage. This is a step in **bacterial lipid A biosynthesis**, contributing to the lipid A portion of lipopolysaccharide.

A reviewed reference annotates residue 256 as a proton acceptor active-site residue. No cofactor is specified in the retrieved annotations.
